methodology: Post-cutoff PDB structural-novelty cohort. Experimental and predicted target coordinates share sequence and observed residue identities; predicted coordinates are aligned offline by explicit C-alpha correspondence for visualization only. Prediction accuracy qualifies the panel and is not a binder endpoint. Binder comparison results remain pending until the four production workers complete.
limitations: Foldseek novelty is maximum detected query-length-normalized similarity to an available pre-cutoff PDB reference, not an exhaustive reconstructed training-manifest comparison.
Prediction confidence (pTM/pLDDT) is shown separately from measured TM-score and C-alpha lDDT.
Designed proteins are eligible and labeled; distillation independence is not claimed.
The viewer provides computational structural comparison and no wet-lab validation.

production_results.summary: Predicted inputs increased mean binder pTM by 0.0482 (95% CI 0.0202 to 0.0735) for mini-proteins and 0.0215 (0.0121 to 0.0311) for nanobodies. Nanobody hydrogen-bond counts decreased by 0.171 (−0.335 to −0.017). The other nine endpoint/modality intervals included zero; their estimates and intervals are shown below. These results do not establish equivalence or non-inferiority, and the larger target-specific changes remain visible in the per-target figures.
production_results.methods: All 4,000 attempts have all six metrics and passed independent artifact audits. Each cell contains 100 attempts. Equal weight is given to ten targets; intervals use 10,000 paired target-bootstrap replicates and are pointwise, unadjusted. These computational endpoints do not measure experimental binding success.

figures.title: Six-score comparison
figures.caption: Small points show ten paired target means; large points and bars show equal-target means and pointwise 95% target-bootstrap intervals. Blue: experimental; orange: predicted.

figures.title: Paired target differences
figures.caption: Predicted minus experimental input. Pointwise 95% paired target-bootstrap intervals; no multiple-comparison adjustment. Intervals crossing zero do not establish equivalence.

figures.title: Mini-protein results by target
figures.caption: Each point averages 100 attempts for one target and condition. Lines connect the paired conditions.
